description: This file defines the 'GrainDirectoryPartition' class which manages a segment of a distributed grain directory within Orleans runtime. The class handles membership snapshots, range locks, snapshot transfers, ownership assertions, and recovery processes for grains in a distributed system.

classes.name: PartitionSnapshotState
classes.description: A record class maintaining state related to a specific snapshot of a directory partition, including version, addresses, and transfer partners.

methods.name: CreateGrainId
methods.description: Creates a unique grain ID for a given silo address and partition index.

methods.name: RefreshViewAsync
methods.description: Refreshes the current membership view to a specific version asynchronously.

methods.name: GetSnapshotAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a snapshot of the partition for a specified range and version.

methods.name: AcknowledgeSnapshotTransferAsync
methods.description: Acknowledges the transfer of a snapshot to a silo for a specific range and version.

methods.name: RemoveSnapshotTransferPartner
methods.description: Removes transfer partner information for specific snapshots.

methods.name: WaitForRange
methods.description: Waits asynchronously until a specified range and version are unlocked.

methods.name: GetPartitionReference
methods.description: Gets a reference to another partition on a specific silo address.

methods.name: OnShuttingDown
methods.description: Performs cleanup tasks when the partition is shutting down.

methods.name: OnSiloRemovedFromClusterAsync
methods.description: Handles cluster reconfiguration when a silo is removed.

methods.name: ProcessMembershipUpdateAsync
methods.description: Processes updates to the cluster membership snapshot asynchronously.

methods.name: ReleaseRangeAsync
methods.description: Releases ownership of a range during membership changes.

methods.name: AcquireRangeAsync
methods.description: Acquires ownership of a range during membership transitions.

methods.name: TransferSnapshotAsync
methods.description: Transfers a snapshot of data from a previous owner silo.

methods.name: RecoverPartitionRange
methods.description: Recovers a range of a partition after a membership change.

methods.name: CheckIntegrityAsync
methods.description: Checks the integrity of the directory's data and ownerships.
